newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore's PAP says wins poll majority before vote.
newsitem.headline: Singapore's PAP says wins poll majority before vote.

text.p: Singapore's ruling People's Action Party (PAP) has won a parliamentary majority ahead of elections because opposition parties will contest only 36 of the 83 seats, government and party sources said on Monday.
A senior government official, who asked not to be identified, told reporters shortly after nominations closed that opposition parties would put up 36 candidates, giving the PAP 47 uncontested seats.
Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong was expected to announce a date for the election later in the day. Most analysts expect a poll date in early January.
The PAP has won every Singapore election since 1959 and in the outgoing parliament the opposition held only four of the 81 seats. Redrawn constituency boundaries have added another two seats.
